title: Vision Module Contract
description: Design contract for modules/vision. Vision is the only module allowed to touch a live product (via browser automation, once implemented). It turns a capture request into organized screenshot/video evidence on disk, following the Tier 1/2/3 escalation ladder in 00_Project_Management/Benchmark_Workflow.md. This file is not implemented or enforced anywhere yet — it exists to pin the shape orchestrator/ and modules/analysis/ will eventually agree on.

JourneyStepId.description: One of the 12 canonical journey steps, matching Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's schema.journey_steps.

CaptureTier.description: The escalation tier from Benchmark_Workflow.md. tier_1 is attempted first, always.

EvidenceLabel.description: Required on every finding not directly observed via Playwright. Mirrors the 'Evidence Labeling' table in Benchmark_Workflow.md.

VisionInput.description: What the orchestrator asks Vision to go capture for one company.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract the caller was built against. Required so the engine can detect drift before it ships bad data.

run_id.description: Identifier for this benchmark run. Expected to align with a Benchmark_Requests.json request id (e.g. 'req_20260707_001') plus the target company slug, so a future orchestrator can post progress back to the existing Queue without inventing a second id scheme.

slug.description: Matches the key used in Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's companies object.

url.description: Optional — absent for companies that are hybrid-research-only.

category.description: Optional. One of: AI-first, OTA, Airline, Big Tech, Super App.

benchmark_type.description: Matches BENCHMARK_TYPES in 10_Dashboard/lib/requestsStore.js — determines how much of the journey Vision is asked to cover.

scope.description: Optional. Matches SCOPE_OPTIONS in requestsStore.js. Narrows which surfaces Vision should prioritize.

journey_steps.description: Which steps to attempt capture for, in priority order. For 'Feature Benchmark' this is typically a single step; for 'Complete Journey' this is all 12.

capture_tier_preference.description: Optional starting tier. Vision still escalates automatically per the workflow's fix-attempt rules regardless of this hint.

output_dir.description: Optional override. Defaults to the existing convention: 03_Screenshots/{company.name}/{NN_step_name}/.

VisionOutput.description: What Vision hands back to Analysis once capture finishes (successfully or via hybrid fallback).

capture_method.description: Optional free-text summary, matching metadata.json's existing 'capture_method' field, e.g. 'Playwright (Tier 1) — primary AI surfaces observed; chatbot login-gated'.

steps.description: One entry per journey step that was attempted, whether it succeeded or not.

state_captures.description: Zero or more captured assets for this step. Empty means the step was attempted but nothing was captured (see failures).

state.description: Which of the 'States to Always Capture' this asset represents.

file_path.description: Optional — absent when evidence_label indicates no visual asset exists (e.g. RESEARCHED-WEB, NOT-FOUND).

notes.description: Optional free text, e.g. voice-input availability, AI-memory behavior observed at capture time.

embedded_vs_sidebar.description: Optional. One of: embedded, sidebar, none — whether AI on this step is woven into the UI or a chatbot overlay.

failures.description: Optional. One entry per step where Tier 1 failed and Vision had to escalate or give up, per the workflow's 'Common Playwright fixes' table.

fix_attempts.description: Optional log of fixes tried before escalating.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in this capture set, mirroring the 'Confidence level' line in hybrid-mode journey step files.
